svg.title: Independence dates of West African countries
svg.desc: Map of West Africa with each country's year of independence: Ghana 1957 (first in British West Africa), Guinea 1958, most French colonies and Nigeria in 1960, Sierra Leone 1961, The Gambia 1965, Guinea-Bissau 1974 (recognised by Portugal; declared 1973) and Cabo Verde 1975. Liberia was never colonised and has been independent since 1847.
